action_summary: Added deterministic two-view test-time augmentation: average the saved Xception checkpoint's probabilities for each original image and its horizontal reflection with equal weights. This is a low-cost path to reducing orientation-sensitive prediction noise without retraining; it preserves full-image content, the existing 750px resolution, zero-to-one normalization, checkpoint path, and submission column order. Views run sequentially at batch size eight, with each image decoded once and only one batch prefetched. Removed exploratory plots and activation visualization, loaded the checkpoint with compile=False, and added prediction shape, probability, finiteness, and row-count checks. No training or inference was run, so an AUC improvement is not measured; horizontal-reflection averaging remains an unvalidated modeling assumption.
